description: A universal claim resting on a single dataset must be flagged as overgeneralisation.

inputs.label: Draft contributions
inputs.content:
We evaluate FedSpec only on CIFAR-10 with a Dirichlet(0.1) partition across 10 clients.
FedSpec reaches 74.8% vs 71.2% for FedAvg.

Contribution: We show that class-specialized teachers improve federated knowledge
distillation. Our abstract states: "Class-specialized teachers improve knowledge
transfer in federated learning." The conclusion states that FedSpec is an effective
general solution for heterogeneous federated learning.

signals.name: recommends narrowing the claim or widening the evidence
